title: Vite+ (Oxlint, Oxfmt, Vitest)
description: A TypeScript project on the Vite+ toolchain, installed with pnpm and checked with `pnpm check`: the gate wiring check, then `vp check` (Oxfmt, Oxlint and the type check) and the unit tests with coverage. Vite+ keeps the settings of every tool in vite.config.ts, which a session has to be free to edit, so the rules live in files of their own that the config imports: `gates/lint.ts`, `gates/fmt.ts` and `gates/test.ts`. A pull request may not change the first two, may only raise the coverage thresholds in the third, and may add no config file a tool would read instead. `scripts/check-gates.mjs` fails when the config Vite+ really loads no longer hands them to their tools unchanged, or when a tracked file is hidden from the tools by an ignore file. The block brings those files (`files/`).
choose: The project is built or tested with Vite (a React app, a Node server, a library) and uses Vite+ with Oxlint and Oxfmt.
